name: View From the Window
purpose: this installation is the F47 window-view shown to visitors and on dashboards.
concierge_blurb: From this height the rooftop gardens of F58 are visible on a clear day. The view changes with the tower's weather.

live_signals.view_text: This afternoon the clouds are low; F58's rooftop gardens hidden until they lift.
visible_on_clear_day: lift cables threading the south face

lessons_learned_for_next_agent: time_of_day must be derived at READ time, not stamped once at build time — a vista room's whole point is that it changes. The cleanest contract is for the dashboard handler to recompute view_text + time_of_day from the local clock on every fetch, treating the JSON's live_signals as a SEED/template. weather has no API source (web_access_autonomous_enabled = false) so it must stay a poetic short-string, never a feed; if a real weather feed is ever wired, it goes through the consult tool and writes to a separate weather_feed.jsonl, not into this room file. evidence_paths intentionally lists NO host paths and NO src/ files — vista is pure narration, not code.
